description: This file defines a Java interface for data access operations related to 'Note' entities, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to provide CRUD functionalities and a custom finder method.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for 'Note' entities, providing basic CRUD operations and a customized method to find notes by user ID ordered by update time descending.

methods.name: findByUserIdOrderByUpdatedAtDesc
methods.description: Custom query method to retrieve a list of notes associated with a specific user ID, ordered by the 'updatedAt' timestamp in descending order.
